description: This file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically related to FIPS endpoint configuration management. The class provides methods to create configuration providers based on environment variables, INI files, or fallback options, and supports composition of multiple providers with caching capabilities.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods for creating configuration providers for AWS FIPS endpoint settings, supporting environment variables, ini files, and fallback options, with support for chaining and caching.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider chaining environment variables, ini files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a provider that reads the configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a provider that reads the configuration from an ini file, with optional profile and filename specifications.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Creates a fallback provider that sets configuration based on the region string.
